run_make_test_data: run make_test_data.py with input caldata pickle and output pickle path arguments
create_compressed_calibration_dataset: create a compressed calibration dataset by JPEG-encoding images at quality 50 and saving to pickle
detect_corners_in_calibration_data: detect corners in calibration data using the eyehandcal.utils detect_corners function
shuffle_and_sample_calibration_data: shuffle calibration data and sample the first 20 entries for testing
review_make_test_data_script: review the make_test_data.py script that prepares compressed test data for eye-hand calibration
